record.reason: Full text presents Squeezeformer, a Transformer architecture for ASR that uses temporal U-Net downsampling to reduce attention cost on long sequences. This is a concrete sequence-model efficiency technique but is specialized to speech recognition; the paper does not establish LLM inference performance or a direct transfer path.
record.title: Squeezeformer: An Efficient Transformer for Automatic Speech Recognition
